g.text: Recording profiles in one isolated Windows guest
Different encoders, quality controls and encoded durations. No CPU winner claim. All local repetitions retained.
Private memory includes children. CPU 100% = one logical core. GPU load not measured. Raw ~200 ms samples are archived.
